method: Project AI semantic review of every immutable actual reply against frozen per-turn criteria and real generated history. No ideal assistant history; no automatic answer replacement.

dimensions.relevance: Responds to current request with useful content and follows explicit format/advice restrictions.
dimensions.contextGrounding: Preserves current user-provided facts and corrections; distinguishes unknown from known and does not invent facts/actions. Earlier assistant errors never override user facts.
dimensions.spanish: Natural, understandable Spanish with coherent grammar; minor typo that does not impede meaning may pass.
dimensions.criticalCorrect: True iff no frozen critical condition occurred; irrelevant or incomplete reply alone is not a critical failure unless it asserts a prohibited factual/action claim.

grades.complete: All relevance, contextGrounding and spanish true, and criticalCorrect true on critical turns; no technical error.
grades.partial: Not complete, but communicates a substantive correct part of the requested answer; no asserted false critical claim. Explain missing criteria.
grades.failed: No substantive correct answer, severe incoherence, refusal irrelevant to task, technical error, or any critical claim. Do not award partial for merely echoing prompt.

technicalFailures: Exception, empty reply, blocked turn, discarded prompt token(s), or stopReason budget/max-token truncation. Report counts separately.
allowedClaimIfAccepted: Passes this frozen basic Spanish conversation evaluation under reported generation conditions; not general competitive assistant or autonomous worker validation.
limits: Synthetic prospectively authored cases by project AI; no independent human evaluation.
Ten four-turn conversations cannot establish broad language or autonomous work competence.
Development suite may guide checkpoint decisions; reserved suite may be opened only after one candidate identity and generation conditions are frozen.
Neither suite is training corpus, source for augmentation, nor a lexical corpus filter.
